method: v8.34 fixed sequence: 9m3m core, non-overlapping 18m9m satellite, non-overlapping 12m6m tertiary
anti_leakage: both input portfolios were frozen independently before results; future columns are removed before deduplication, conflict rejection and exposure caps

closing_value.guardrail: Post-settlement attribution only; closing prices and outcomes never alter eligibility, direction, or stake.

closing_expected_monthly_stability.guardrail: Closing prices are attribution-only and cannot change frozen eligibility, direction or stake. Match outcomes are not used by this diagnostic.

calibrated_concentration_gate.method: fixed-position Bernoulli simulation from closing fair probability
calibrated_concentration_gate.guardrail: Post-settlement gate-power diagnostic only; simulated outcomes never alter historical eligibility, direction, probability, or stake.
